messages:
mike: Quick follow-up from the postmortem - we need final owners for quota/backstop, autoscaler tweaks, headroom model, and recurrence alerting. Keep it light: owners + one measurable acceptance per task.
laura: I'll take headroom model. Deliver a 4-week rolling headroom dashboard and an explanatory blurb for oncall. ETA 2026-04-05.
diego: Autoscaler tweaks - I'll take. Plan: small canary, measure p99 delta and token cost. PR will include staging override snippet. ETA 2026-03-29.
sasha: Quota/backstop is mine. I'll propose a per-customer soft cap and an emergency override. Will coordinate with finance for billing impact. ETA 2026-04-01.
mike: Also we need recurrence detection: Diego, can you add a short Prom rule for 5m sustained gpu_util > 0.8? If it matches the surge signature, it should create a digest.
diego: Yep, will add that and attach a unit test for the rule.
ticket-bot: incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem action items due in 2 weeks.
mike: Owners + acceptance:
- headroom dashboard: Laura - 2026-04-05 - accept: dashboard + oncall blurb
- autoscaler canary: Diego - 2026-03-29 - accept: staging run + canary 12h stable
- quota/backstop policy: Sasha - 2026-04-01 - accept: policy doc + staging config
- recurrence alert: Diego - 2026-03-27 - accept: Prom rule + digest test
laura: I'll include a small surge sim harness to validate the dashboard.
sasha: Procurement looped for pricing. Also adding a fallback policy for tenant-level throttles.
diego: Scheduling the canary for Fri 01:00 UTC. Will post results.
mike: Thanks. I'll create the GH board and assign cards by EOD. Please add one test case to your PRs that verifies regression guard.
